title: "The Gears of War trilogy was largely developed hungover by me" - Cliff Bleszinski reckons with a difficult past while plotting a return to games and a brighter future - Eurogamer.net
summary: Veteran game designer Cliff Bleszinski has candidly revealed a career-long struggle with alcohol, admitting he largely developed the *Gears of War* trilogy while consistently hungover. Bleszinski, who served as the prominent public face for the original three games, stated he is now reckoning with his past personal challenges. This disclosure comes as the influential developer signals his intention to return to the gaming industry, aiming for a brighter future. His frankness sheds light on the internal struggles faced by high-profile figures in game development, emphasizing a renewed focus on personal well-being alongside his professional ambitions.

title: 70+ PS5, PS4 Games to Buy in PS Store's Massive Summer Sale (North America/Europe) - Push Square
summary: The PlayStation Store has launched its extensive Summer Sale, offering thousands of discounted PS5 and PS4 games for players across North America and Europe. This significant promotion, running until August 12th, provides a prime opportunity for gamers to acquire a wide array of popular titles at reduced prices. The sale features numerous recommended games, presenting a substantial chance for PlayStation enthusiasts to expand their digital libraries and enjoy high-quality entertainment without paying full price. It's a major event for those looking to secure new games before the summer ends.
